source_doc.title: NVIDIA PR: NVIDIA Announces Strategic Partnership With Lumentum to Develop State-of-the-Art Optics Technology——LITE→UHP laser sole_source 降級 addendum（自主研究迴圈第 8 輪）
source_doc.permission_basis: Corporate press release intended for public distribution; brief quotations stored in library/raw and this extraction.

sources.quote: NVIDIA is investing $2 billion in Lumentum to support R&D, future capacity and operations as the company builds out its U.S.-based manufacturing capabilities in a new fab.
The nonexclusive agreement includes an NVIDIA multibillion purchase commitment and future capacity access rights for advanced laser components.

claims.statement: LITE→UHP laser 的 sole_source=True 應視為 weak：①該邊全部 origin 僅 Lumentum 自家文件（L8 第 3 條機械觸發——供應商自稱 sole_source 無客戶端/第三方印證）；②客戶端反證——NVIDIA 對 Lumentum 的協議由 NVIDIA 自家 PR 明文為 nonexclusive，且 NVIDIA 同日（2026-03-02）對 Coherent 作成對稱的 $2B 投資＋採購承諾（nvda_coherent_partnership_pr_2026_03_02 在圖），Cignal AI 另記載 Coherent 同應用高功率雷射 PO——買方行為是刻意雙源，不是獨供。
claims.disproof_condition: 若客戶端文件（NVIDIA filing/PR）明示 UHP 外部光源獨供 Lumentum、或 Coherent 高功率雷射 PO 被取消且無其他供應商，恢復 sole_source 強度。
